title: Administrator/Coordinator
description:
Administrator/ Coordinator
Location: Basingstoke (Hybrid option of 1 day a week from home available)
Salary: £13.50 per hour
Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday
Contract Type: This is a temporary assignment for 12 weeks, with possibility to remain further.

About the Role
We are seeking a proactive and detail oriented Administrator/Coordinator to join a specialist team based in Basingstoke. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

As a coordinator you will be working with the service team who have a backlog You will assist them with working through safety checks - contacting customers to gain access and complete them . This requires a good communicator with the ability to adapt to various customer types as well as someone well organised to coordinate the checks being completed.
Key Responsibilities:
- To work within the service team assisting with booking in safety checks
- Raise and manage internal and external work orders for servicing
- Ensure that the bookings are costed, closed, and processed accurately and within set timeframes
- Liaise with customers via the telephone to book in service visits
- Liaise with third party providers and clients to schedule in work to be completed
- Co-ordinate diaries and visits
- Process purchase orders and data using excel
- Generate regular reports
- Respond to telephone and Microsoft Teams enquiries in a professional manner
- Carry out general administrative tasks

The ideal Administrator/Coordinator will have/be
- Experience in an office or administrative environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel
- be well organised an able to multitask
- Be a good communicator
- Be available and happy to commit asap

To apply, please submit your CV as soon as possible - or contact the Commercial Team on (phone number removed).
!

title: AV Account Manager
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven AV Account Manager to join our office-based distribution sales team. The successful candidate will play a key role in managing and growing relationships with existing reseller partners, while developing new business opportunities within the professional Audio-Visual (AV) market.

This position is ideal for a motivated sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced distribution environment, with a passion for AV technology, customer service excellence, and solution-based selling.

Key Responsibilities
- Account Management
- Manage a portfolio of existing AV reseller and integrator accounts, ensuring strong relationships and customer satisfaction.
- Proactively identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across product ranges and vendors.
- Maintain regular contact with customers through calls, emails, and virtual meetings to understand business needs and project requirements.
- New Business Development
- Identify, qualify, and onboard new reseller accounts.
- Actively prospect and engage with potential partners to expand market share and revenue streams.
- Sales & Commercial Activity
- Achieve and exceed monthly sales and margin targets.
- Prepare competitive quotations and negotiate pricing within approved frameworks.
- Maintain accurate CRM records of all customer interactions, opportunities, and forecasts.
- Product Knowledge & Vendor Liaison
- Develop a strong understanding of the AV product portfolio, including displays, projection, collaboration systems, control, and signal management.
- Work closely with vendor partners and internal product specialists to ensure customer solutions are technically sound and commercially viable.
- Keep up to date with new technologies, promotions, and industry developments.
- Internal Collaboration
- Coordinate with logistics, purchasing, marketing, and technical teams to ensure smooth order processing and customer satisfaction.
- Provide feedback to product and marketing teams on market trends, customer feedback, and competitive activity.

Skills & Experience Required
- Proven experience in B2 B AV sales, ideally within a distribution or vendor environment.
- Strong knowledge of professional AV technologies (displays, projection, video conferencing, digital signage, etc.).
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong negotiation and commercial awareness.
- Comfortable working with CRM systems and Microsoft Office applications.
- Self-motivated with a proactive approach to achieving targets.
- Ability to thrive in a collaborative team environment.

Desirable Attributes
- Experience working with key AV brands and vendors.
- Knowledge of the UK reseller and systems integrator landscape.
- Familiarity with IT/AV convergence and Unified Communications markets.
- A genuine passion for technology and providing exceptional customer service.

Benefits

Competitive salary and uncapped commission structure.

Pension scheme and other company benefits.

Career progression and professional development opportunities.

Supportive, team-oriented office environment.

title: Credit Controller
description:
The Opportunity

If you are hoping to join a truly fantastic company who foster an outstanding team culture then this could be just they job you have been looking for. The position of Credit Controller is offered on a 3 month contract basis and they also offer a hybrid working pattern. Based in Basingstoke, this is an exceptional opportunity for an experienced credit controller to work with a highly prestigious brand.

Responsibilities
- Collections focused role, maintaining a significant but very well maintained ledger
- Mix of key accounts and smaller companies, including B2 B and B2 C (consumer debt)
- Pro-actively resolving queries
- Performing credit checks where necessary and reviewing existing accounts
- Use of 2 bespoke accounting systems as well as MS Excel

About You
- Suitable applicants will be available on a maximum of a weeks notice
- Shorter term contract can be considered if that suits you
- Must be a very team orientated individual

title: Facilities Co-ordinator
description:
Facilities Co-ordinator

Are you ready to take the next step in your career? Our client, a leading player in the Facilities Management sector, is seeking a dedicated and dynamic facilities admin to join their team in Basingstoke. This is an exciting opportunity to support the management of a vibrant facility, ensuring it operates at peak efficiency while delivering exceptional service.

Key Responsibilities:
- Assist in the day-to-day operations of the centre, ensuring smooth functionality and adherence to organisational standards.
- Support the Centre Manager in overseeing a diverse team, fostering an environment of collaboration and high performance.
- Engage with clients and stakeholders to understand their needs and ensure satisfaction with facilities and services.
- Monitor and report on key performance indicators, contributing to strategic planning and improvements.
- Lead by example in promoting health and safety practises, ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations.
- Assist in the management of budgets and resources, identifying opportunities for cost savings and efficiency improvements.

The Ideal Candidate Will Have:
- Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and motivate a team.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, enabling effective collaboration with clients and staff.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving, with the capacity to think critically and make informed decisions.
- Previous experience in facilities management or a similar role, demonstrating a solid understanding of operational processes.

title: New Enquiries & Customer Administrator
description:
Our client, a well-established company in Basingstoke , is seeking a New Enquiries & Customer Service Advisor to join their team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong customer service skills and a naturally empathetic approach, who enjoys helping people and providing a positive first impression.

The Role

As the first point of contact for prospective clients, you will be responsible for handling incoming enquiries, understanding client needs, and ensuring each caller receives a professional and compassionate service.

Key Responsibilities:
- Answer incoming calls from new and existing clients.
- Listen carefully and respond with empathy and professionalism.
- Gather relevant information and accurately record details.
- Provide excellent customer service at every stage of the client journey.
- Maintain confidential and accurate records.

About You
- Previous customer service, call handling, or contact centre experience is desirable.
- Excellent telephone manner and communication skills.
- Empathetic, patient, and professional approach.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Confident using computer systems and databases.
- Able to remain calm and supportive when speaking with clients about sensitive matters.

What's on Offer?
- Monday-Friday working hours (9:00am-5:00pm).
- Friendly and supportive team environment
